plan.title: Child Fitness Improvement Dashboard
plan.subtitle: Tracking physical progress from baseline to endline by location and coach

panels.title: Total Children Tracked
panels.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "Child ID") AS n FROM (SELECT "Child ID" FROM "baseline" UNION SELECT "Child ID" FROM "endline") AS all_children

panels.title: Avg Shuttle Run Improvement (sec)
panels.sql: SELECT AVG(e."Shuttle run sec" - b."Shuttle run sec") AS n FROM "baseline" b JOIN "endline" e ON b."Child ID" = e."Child ID" WHERE b."Shuttle run sec" IS NOT NULL AND e."Shuttle run sec" IS NOT NULL

panels.title: Avg Sit Ups Improvement
panels.sql: SELECT AVG(e."Sit ups" - b."Sit ups") AS n FROM "baseline" b JOIN "endline" e ON b."Child ID" = e."Child ID" WHERE b."Sit ups" IS NOT NULL AND e."Sit ups" IS NOT NULL

panels.title: Avg Shuttle Run Change by Location
panels.sql: SELECT b."Location", AVG(e."Shuttle run sec" - b."Shuttle run sec") AS avg_change FROM "baseline" b JOIN "endline" e ON b."Child ID" = e."Child ID" WHERE b."Shuttle run sec" IS NOT NULL AND e."Shuttle run sec" IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 20

panels.title: Avg Sit Ups Change by Coach
panels.sql: SELECT b."Coach", AVG(e."Sit ups" - b."Sit ups") AS avg_change FROM "baseline" b JOIN "endline" e ON b."Child ID" = e."Child ID" WHERE b."Sit ups" IS NOT NULL AND e."Sit ups" IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 20

panels.title: Top 10 Locations by Shuttle Run Improvement
panels.sql: SELECT b."Location", COUNT(*) AS child_count, AVG(e."Shuttle run sec" - b."Shuttle run sec") AS avg_improvement FROM "baseline" b JOIN "endline" e ON b."Child ID" = e."Child ID" WHERE b."Shuttle run sec" IS NOT NULL AND e."Shuttle run sec" IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 3 DESC LIMIT 10

plan.narrative:
This dashboard tracks the physical fitness progress of children from baseline to endline assessments. The total number of unique children tracked is {{p1}}. On average, children improved their shuttle run time by {{p2}} seconds, indicating better speed and agility. Additionally, the average increase in sit-ups was {{p3}} repetitions, showing enhanced core strength.

The bar chart by location highlights which areas saw the most significant improvements in shuttle run times, with the top performing locations leading the pack. Similarly, the coach-specific analysis reveals which instructors are driving the most substantial gains in core strength exercises.

For a detailed breakdown, the table lists the top 10 locations where children showed the greatest improvement in shuttle run performance, providing actionable insights for resource allocation and coaching strategies.
